source: Bowers, N.R., Gegenfurtner, K.R. & Goettker, A. (2025). Chromatic and achromatic contrast sensitivity in the far periphery. Journal of Vision, 25(11):7.
figure: Figure 3 — Normalized sensitivity as function of eccentricity
notes: Values normalized to 5° baseline (=100%). THRESHOLD detection sensitivity (CSF), NOT suprathreshold appearance. Stimuli: 15° Gabor gratings. Three eccentricities extracted here: 5°, 15°, 75° (paper tested 5, 15, 45, 60, 75, 90°). RG decay is biphasic (steep to ~15°, then slows); castleCSF exponential over-predicts beyond ~20°.
